facts.fact: GRAIN's comparative study says Burkina Faso's personal data protection law is the only one of the four countries' to explicitly reference processing based on artificial intelligence.
facts.system: Burkina Faso personal data protection law

facts.fact: GRAIN's study says none of the four countries, Senegal included, has an AI-specific law or mandatory mechanisms for algorithmic transparency, audit or redress for AI discrimination.
